title: Conference handover marks stage Upgraded before the invites and the 1:1 discard are sent; a refused send is never retried
trigger: Add people to a 1:1 call; the conference gets its link; the sender refuses discardCall (client closing or native error)
effect: 1:1 call stays up with the conference already running; the peer never receives the link and the handover is not retried
fix: Move to Upgraded only after discard_call_with_link went out, keep Handover on a refused send so the next ingest retries

title: getChatInviteLinks goes out with creator_user_id 0 while the own user id is unknown
trigger: Open the invite links dialog right after sign-in, before getMe answers; fetch_chat_invite_links sends creator 0 which its own comment says TDLib rejects (400)
effect: The list lands in Failed with a server error instead of waiting for the id; the sibling fetch_revoked_chat_invite_links waits
fix: Return Ok(None) (leave the list Idle) until my_user_id is known, as fetch_revoked_chat_invite_links does

title: group_bot_users_tick takes the whole wanted list and drops each bot whose getUser send fails
trigger: A group's bot_commands list names a bot the session has not cached; the poll runs while the sender refuses (client closing or native error); the wish is only re-added when the group's full info is stored again
effect: The / menu of that group never lists the bot until the full info arrives again
fix: Keep the wish until its getUser went out (re-push on a refused send), or hold it as a Fetch::Failed entry in bot_users

title: Rate-limit retry keeps its attempt count in a raw-u64 map beside the retry list
trigger: A read gets a 429: flood_retries holds the json and due time, flood_attempts (HashMap<u64,u8>) holds the count; removed by hand in four places and swept by forget_flood_attempts_of_gone_requests
effect: No bug today; the two collections and the sender's retained json must be kept in step by hand
fix: One map RequestId -> FloodStage { Waiting { json, due, attempt }, Resent { attempt } } removed with the request

title: ActiveScreen::paused duplicates GroupScreenShare::Sharing { paused }
trigger: Shared window hides: set_screen_paused writes active.paused and call.screen_share.set_paused; both are reset by hand in pump_shared_screen (wanted None) and stop_sharing_screen
effect: No bug today; two fields of one fact (is the share paused) that must change together
fix: Keep paused only in GroupScreenShare (or only in the capture) and derive the other

title: Business save in flight is a Vec of (RequestId, kind) beside a hand-cleared error Option
trigger: Every business sender (start page, chat links, bot, sponsored, greeting, away, hours, location) sets settings.business.error = None itself before sending; saving is a Vec pushed after the send
effect: No bug today; a missed clear in a new sender would leave the previous refusal on screen
fix: A BusinessSave enum per kind { Idle, Saving { request }, Failed(reason) } so starting a save replaces the failure
